title: Move top-level 'scope' → 'account scope'
description: Move the 'scope add' and 'scope list' commands from the top-level 'scope' branch into a new 'account scope' sub-branch. Scope management is account-scoped, so it belongs under the 'account' group. Keep the top-level 'scope' branch as a deprecated alias. This makes the command hierarchy semantically coherent with the rest of the account group.
prerequisiteState: Stories 1–27 complete. 'scope add' and 'scope list' are registered at the top level. The 'account' branch has login, list, show, set-default, remove, re-auth, rename commands.
goal: After this story: 'zapi account scope add --scope ZohoCliq.Channels.READ' works. 'zapi account scope list' works. 'zapi scope add' and 'zapi scope list' still work but print deprecation warnings.
scope: In src/ZapiCli/Program.cs, within the 'account' branch lambda: add account.AddBranch("scope", scope => { scope.AddCommand<ScopeAddCommand>("add"); scope.AddCommand<ScopeListCommand>("list"); });

Verify that the 'account' branch can contain both leaf commands (login, list, show, etc.) and a sub-branch (scope). Use the existing 'config' branch pattern (which has both a 'set' sub-branch and a 'show' leaf) as a reference.

Keep the top-level 'scope' branch but replace its command registrations with deprecated shims: ScopeAddDeprecatedCommand and ScopeListDeprecatedCommand that call DeprecationHelper.Warn("scope add", "account scope add") / DeprecationHelper.Warn("scope list", "account scope list").
The ScopeAddCommand and ScopeListCommand classes themselves are unchanged — they keep their existing flags (including --port if present), output format, and error codes.
Do NOT rename the ScopeAddCommand or ScopeListCommand classes.
acceptanceCriteria: 'zapi account scope add --scope ZohoCliq.Channels.READ' executes correctly
'zapi account scope list' lists scopes for the default account
'zapi scope add --scope ...' still executes correctly and prints a deprecation warning
'zapi scope list' still works with a deprecation warning
The 'account --help' output lists 'scope' as a sub-command group
contextForAgent: Read the ScopeAddCommand and ScopeListCommand classes to understand their Settings (particularly --port if present). Read the current top-level scope branch registration in Program.cs. The deprecated shim commands should have identical Settings to the originals so that all flags are forwarded correctly. The simplest shim pattern: subclass ScopeAddCommand, override Execute/ExecuteAsync to call DeprecationHelper.Warn first and then call base.ExecuteAsync.
